shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
npm run start >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
trap '"'kill "'$PID >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'"' EXIT
sleep 3
curl -s -o /tmp/admin.out -D /tmp/admin.headers http://127.0.0.1:3000/admin
head -n 20 /tmp/admin.headers
printf \"\\n--- body snippet ---\\n\"
head -c 400 /tmp/admin.out
"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "403 Forbidden|You do not have access|admin role" /tmp/admin.out -S'
